decisions.statement: A reading is found by agent and then by path.
Which agents there are is read from the index rather than from a folder.
A line has the path read.
A line has the object id of the body read.
A line carries when the path was read.
A line has the object id a carry left.
A line written before the carried oid was named has that oid under `mechanicalOid`.
A line carries how far into the body the agent has read.
A line carrying no reach into the body means the whole body reached the agent.
A reading carrying a reach into the body answers no body.
An object id is git's own over the bytes that were read.
An agent's readings sit in one file beside that agent's own page.
An agent no page names holds no reading, and a read of one records nothing.
The record is written again from no page.
One agent's readings are one agent's own file.
A reading is appended, and the last line naming a path is that path's reading.
A body answers a reading where the body is the body read or the body a carry left.
Reading a body again clears the object id a carry left.
A carry moves a reading of the changed file onto the body and path the change left.
A reading is carried only where its body is the body the carry started from.
A carry moves how far into the body the agent had read.
The body a carry left answers the question a warrant asks.
The body a carry left does not answer writing over that body itself.
The record's owner is the seat or the subagent acting under that seat.
A subagent's readings are its own.
A subagent begins with no reading its seat holds.
A subagent's readings outlive its page going and coming back.
The readings a subagent made move onto its seat as its page goes, as its edits do.
A seat keeps those readings beside itself rather than among its own.
A reading a seat keeps that way says which subagent made it.
A reading left beside a page going that moved nowhere goes with that page.
A reading a seat keeps that way answers nothing the seat itself is asked.
A subagent whose page comes back takes back the readings the seat kept for it.
A reading goes back only to a page taken up under the agent id that reading was made by.
A page composed fresh takes back no reading, whatever path that page is written at.
A reading going back loses the agent id the seat kept it under.
A reading the seat keeps for another agent is left where it is.
A reading a seat keeps goes where a sweep takes its agent's page away.
A page taken down any other way leaves the readings the seat keeps for it.
An acting name the seat's id does not begin is not honoured.
The seat owns the record when an acting name does not begin with its id.
A removal forgets the reading of the path that went for every agent.
Forgetting a reading writes the file again without the lines that go.
A reading last seen before a moment handed in is swept, whoever holds it.
A reading whose line will not read goes with the next write of that file.
A writer of one of these files takes a lock keyed on that file.
A read whose output would not reach the agent is refused and leaves no reading.
Whether a read's output reached the agent is judged elsewhere and read here.
Nothing is in the record that did not reach the agent.

definition: what an agent has read, kept beside that agent's page and answered in one file read
